name: bizplug-grocery
description: The grocery & supermarkets plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: build a pickup or delivery list. It works from the business's own published profile, covering specials, departments, pickup and delivery, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
